scope: Comparison of firmware-derived colour with camera JPEGs. Metrics only; no image data is stored here. The colour tables themselves are in analysis/k3iii-color-tables.json.

method.image: half-size image from 2x2 CFA cells, as-shot white balance, 16x16-pixel block means
method.alignment: affine registration of the rendering onto the camera JPEG (ECC); geometry only
method.flat_blocks: blocks whose mean differs from the neighbours by less than 2 code values (8 bit) per block step, three blocks from the border excluded
method.metric: CIEDE2000 between block means, camera JPEG decoded in its own colour space
method.settings: the Custom Image settings of each shot are read from maker-note tag 0x0247 (the routine at 0x52f835dc copies its first six values into the tuning input); the profile is built for those settings
method.lightness_difference: CIE L* of the rendering minus L* of the camera JPEG, flat blocks with chroma below 5; negative = rendering darker

samples.scene: outdoor, colour cube on white paper and black cloth

result.camera_jpeg: preview stored in the RAW file

samples.licence: not redistributed; fetched for comparison only

result.baseline_exposure_source: firmware formula with the maker-note exposure gain

control.description: Natural parameters applied to the Bright sample (scratch script, half-size blocks, flat blocks with chroma of 50 or more); computed with all settings 0, before the shot's settings were read

profile_against_model.description: Each of the 16 published profiles rendered with the DNG reference pipeline against the colour model it was built from; 60,000 random scene colours per class, CIEDE2000. Full figures: analysis/k3iii-profile-accuracy.json (tools/check_profile_accuracy.py).
profile_against_model.design_note: ForwardMatrix holds the sensor matrix shared by all Custom Images; the Custom Image's matrix and the camera's gamut clip are in the LookTable. An earlier design (ForwardMatrix = whole colour matrix, smooth continuation outside the gamut) turned saturated blues black in vivid modes (CIEDE2000 up to 40-56 against the model) and was dropped.

adobe_sdk_cross_check.description: LookTable and tone curve of the 16 published profiles run through RefBaselineHueSatMap and RefBaselineRGBTone compiled from Adobe DNG SDK 1.7.1 (dng_reference.cpp), against tools/firmware_color_model.py; 200,000 random colours each; difference in sRGB 8-bit code values
adobe_sdk_cross_check.not_covered: profile parsing, colour matrices and exposure handling by SDK code (the full SDK needs libjxl and was not built); Lightroom itself
adobe_sdk_cross_check.tool: tools/check_dcp_against_sdk.py with tools/dng_sdk_harness.cpp (SDK source supplied by the user)

exploratory_checks_not_reproducible_from.note: Run with scratch scripts while the model was being worked out; kept as a record of what was ruled out.
exploratory_checks_not_reproducible_from.exposure_gain_in_curve_instead_of_input: curve computed for gain 10305 with unscaled input on #4678: flat chroma>=50 blocks 4.69 against 0.31 for the adopted model (input scaled by 8192/gain, nominal curve)
exploratory_checks_not_reproducible_from.chroma_suppress_stage: Imaging Resource sample, flat blocks with chroma 5 to 15: 1.81 without the stage, 1.09 with it
exploratory_checks_not_reproducible_from.multi_axis_stock_parameters: treating the stock multi-axis matrix as highlight desaturation worsened bright saturated blocks (0.87 to 1.09); treating it as stored (1.0 = 1024) worsened neutral blocks (1.4 to 2.2). No effect is modelled.

limits: Two scenes, both ISO 100, taken with camera firmware 1.01 and 1.10; the analysed firmware is 2.20.

Only Natural (all settings 0) and Bright (contrast +1) were compared. The other 14 profiles, and the key, highlight-contrast and shadow-contrast settings that some of them ship with, were not compared with camera output.

Both shots had Shadow Correction on Auto; the emulated tone-control table is the identity. In flat neutral areas the model is 0.2 L* (Bright sample) and 0.5 L* (Natural sample) darker than the camera JPEG.
The profile rendering is the DNG SDK reference pipeline, not Lightroom. Lightroom was not run.
With a negative total exposure (#4678) the reference pipeline folds the exposure into the tone curve after the LookTable; saturated colours then differ more (1.00 against 0.42 for the model).
Toning (Muted, Bleach Bypass, HARUBENI) is in the model but cannot be put into a profile; neither sample uses it.

settings_control.description: Bright sample rendered with all settings 0 instead of the settings recorded in the file (contrast +1); flat blocks, mean CIEDE2000
settings_control.note: Until the setting record was found, this sample was compared with all settings 0 (1.38); the published v0.5.0 draft figures were those.
